remoteai.ssh.serverTarballPath.description: Local path to the remote-ai-server tarball used when installing a missing remote server.

remoteai.ssh.serverManifestPath.description: Local path to an Aura release manifest. Used to select commit, tarball and sha256 when serverTarballPath is not set.

remoteai.ssh.commit.description: Remote server commit directory. Defaults to the running application's commit, or dev when running from sources.

remoteai.ssh.defaultRemotePath.description: Default remote folder path shown by the connect command.

aura.runtime.manifestPath.description: Local Aura Code runtime manifest path. Leave empty to use the bundled manifest.

aura.runtime.bundledRoot.description: Local directory containing bundled Aura Code runtime tarballs. Leave empty to use the application resource directory.

aura.runtime.networkEnabled.description: Allow Aura Code to use network runtime sources when local cache and bundled runtime packages are missing.

aura.runtime.remoteDownloadEnabled.description: Allow the SSH server to download AI runtime packages directly from the runtime manifest URL before falling back to local download and upload.

remoteai.codex.credentialsSyncEnabled.description: Automatically sync local Codex auth.json and config.toml to the SSH server for remote Codex sessions.

remoteai.codex.credentialsOverwrite.description: Overwrite existing remote Codex auth.json and config.toml during SSH activation so the remote session receives the latest local Codex configuration.

remoteai.codex.remoteCliPath.description: Explicit Codex CLI path on the SSH server. Leave empty to let Aura Code Runtime Manager install or select the managed runtime.

remoteai.codex.sandboxMode.description: Sandbox mode passed to the remote Codex CLI wrapper.

remoteai.codex.bypassApprovalsAndSandbox.description: Pass --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox to the remote Codex CLI wrapper. This is off by default.
